note: Descriptions and inputSchema are the actual MCP tools/list capture (evidence/v2/mcp-tool-schemas.json, omp-bridge 0.2.0). The simplified input map is a readability aid; the raw schema is shown as captured. Responses marked real come from committed transcripts/evidence; illustrative ones follow the shipped shape but were not captured.

tools.name: omp_start
tools.desc: Start an Oh My Pi RPC v2 session. Private by default; daemon mode shares sessions with an exclusive controller lease.

input.cwd: string? — Existing working directory for the agent. Defaults to bridge working directory.
input.model: string? — Provider/model identifier, passed at process startup.
input.no_tools: boolean? — Disable tools for a minimal inference-only smoke test. Default false.

cwd.description: Existing working directory for the agent. Defaults to bridge working directory.

model.description: Provider/model identifier, passed at process startup.

no_tools.description: Disable tools for a minimal inference-only smoke test. Default false.

tools.name: omp_send
tools.desc: Send a prompt. Returns a bridge operationId; timeout means running_or_unknown, never implicit abort or retry.

input.mode: string? — Normal prompt by default; use dedicated steer/follow-up tools while active.
input.streaming_behavior: string? — Queue a prompt exactly once while streaming: steer or followUp.
input.timeout_ms: integer? — At most 25000 ms. Timeout never aborts or retries the prompt.
input.wait: boolean? — Wait for result up to timeout_ms; false returns an operationId immediately.

example.message: Reply with exactly BRIDGE_E2E_OK and nothing else

mode.description: Normal prompt by default; use dedicated steer/follow-up tools while active.

streaming_behavior.description: Queue a prompt exactly once while streaming: steer or followUp.

timeout_ms.description: At most 25000 ms. Timeout never aborts or retries the prompt.

wait.description: Wait for result up to timeout_ms; false returns an operationId immediately.

tools.name: omp_steer
tools.desc: Steer a running agent at its next step. Sends exactly one RPC steer, never a duplicate fallback prompt.

input.text: string — Message to steer or queue, exactly once.

example.text: Stop listing files — count only the Rust ones.

text.description: Message to steer or queue, exactly once.

tools.name: omp_follow_up
tools.desc: Queue a follow-up for when the agent would otherwise stop. Admission does not mean completion.

input.text: string — Message to steer or queue, exactly once.

example.text: Now summarize the result in one line.

text.description: Message to steer or queue, exactly once.

tools.name: omp_promote_queued_message
tools.desc: Promote a matching queued follow-up into steering without sending it again. Inspect promoted, not object truthiness.

input.text: string — Message to steer or queue, exactly once.

example.text: Now summarize the result in one line.

text.description: Message to steer or queue, exactly once.

tools.name: omp_take_control
tools.desc: Explicitly take the exclusive controller lease for a shared daemon session. Every transfer records its reason in the event stream.

input.reason: string — Human-readable explanation recorded in the controller transfer event.

example.reason: operator handoff: Claude taking over mid-count

reason.description: Human-readable explanation recorded in the controller transfer event.

tools.name: omp_events
tools.desc: Read bounded session events with a cursor and explicit dropped-history indication. Inspect prompt_result.sessionSettled or session_settled to establish settlement.

input.cursor: integer? — Next event cursor to read, initially zero.
input.kinds: array? — Filter this read only; empty means all kinds.

cursor.description: Next event cursor to read, initially zero.

kinds.description: Filter this read only; empty means all kinds.

tools.name: omp_status
tools.desc: Get authoritative agent state and bridge operation outcomes. Completion and session settlement are distinct.

tools.name: omp_messages
tools.desc: Read paginated message history with a stable cursor. Available to observers as well as the controller.

input.cursor: string? — Stable page cursor returned by the previous call.
input.offset: integer? — Legacy offset for starting without a cursor.

cursor.description: Stable page cursor returned by the previous call.

offset.description: Legacy offset for starting without a cursor.

tools.name: omp_set_model
tools.desc: Switch the session model by provider and model_id. Requires the controller lease in daemon mode.

tools.name: omp_compact
tools.desc: Compact conversation context with optional instructions; invokes the model and may consume provider quota.

tools.name: omp_abort
tools.desc: Abort the current agent turn without stopping the process.

tools.name: omp_stop
tools.desc: Stop the session. stopped=true only after confirmed process teardown.

tools.name: omp_list
tools.desc: List sessions: private to this process by default, shared when connected to a daemon.
